summary: Ocean Power Technologies filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $20 million of common stock through sales agent H.C. Wainwright. The stock trades on NYSE American under OPTT; last sale $0.15/share on July 24, 2026. Wainwright receives a 3.0% commission. This is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4), not a special situation. No unusual terms, premiums, or structural complexities. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. Watch for dilution given low share price, but the filing itself is an ordinary ATM program.
